title: caruelina oligantha
intro: Caruelina oligantha, commonly known as "Coral Honeysuckle Vine", is a plant species native to the southeastern United States. This vine is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic nature. The health benefits of Caruelina oligantha include its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
